notes.title: News #8 - 1 year anniversary! 🎂
notes.notes:
It's been a year since the game's release on May 18th, 2022. 🥳 🎂

To celebrate, we're offering a limited time 66% discount on the game!

We want to take this opportunity to thank everyone who has played Icemaze Cave and provided feedback. Your input has been invaluable in making the game better. We appreciate all the positive reviews and constructive criticism.

If you haven't played Icemaze Cave yet, now's the perfect time to explore its icy caverns and solve challenging puzzles. We hope you'll enjoy the game as much as we do!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41583203/1d9d00ffb5d5662b9accac789ae458547f37423f.png[/img]

Got feedback or questions? You can reach us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/gRHWRGWY2n]Discord[/url] or in the Steam [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1834120/discussions]Discussions[/url] forum.

notes.title: Patch Notes #4
notes.notes:
Today's update includes the following changes:
[list]
[*] Bug fix: all menu buttons now work on computers without a sound device. [i](Thanks to [b]Rory[/b] for reporting the issue!)[/i]
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes #3
notes.notes:
Today's update includes the following changes:
[list]
[*] [b]Support for Chinese (Simplified) / 简体中文.[/b] The game can now be played in Chinese (Simplified) by selecting the language in the options menu.
[/list]

notes.title: News #7 - Chinese (Simplified) localization
notes.notes:
We've just added support for a third language: [b]Chinese (Simplified)[/b]!

As the second most used language on Steam and perhaps the most used language on Earth, Chinese (Simplified) was the natural next step for our localization efforts.

Now the 1,000,000,000+ people who may prefer it over our other languages (English and Japanese) can more comfortably enjoy Icemaze Cave.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41583203/123c12467c1361365e80e5c36e7852a58db26cb8.png[/img]

You can choose your preferred language directly in the Steam client or from the in-game "OPTIONS" menu.

[h3]Additional languages[/h3]

We'd like to support even more languages and locales. Would you like to help us translate Icemaze Cave: Skate Escape into your language? Reach out to us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/gRHWRGWY2n]Discord[/url] or in the Steam [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1834120/discussions]Discussions[/url] forum!

notes.title: News #6 - macOS support
notes.notes:
Icemaze Cave: Skate Escape is now available on macOS!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41583203/8e8ec0384c63e76134966359e6527bac61765f5b.png[/img]

Now you can finally skate through the caves even if you're on your Macbook.

A macOS version was one of the first requests we got when Icemaze Cave was released. Happy to oblige!

If you notice any issues with the new macOS version (or any other version), please reach out to us on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.com/invite/gRHWRGWY2n]Discord[/url], in the Steam [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1834120/discussions?snr=1_2108_9__2107]Discussions[/url] forum, or through the Steam support channels.

notes.title: News #5 - Japanese localization
notes.notes:
Today, we added support for a second language: [b]Japanese[/b]!

Japanese-speaking players can now navigate the menus, read the in-game instructions and skim through the credits with ease - all in 日本語.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41583203/0d8ccdae0abbd0c3d945229f510f7eb22e60717c.png[/img]

You can choose your preferred language directly in the Steam client or from the in-game "OPTIONS" menu.

[h3]Additional languages[/h3]

We'd like to support even more languages and locales. Would you like to help us translate Icemaze Cave: Skate Escape into your language? Reach out to us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/gRHWRGWY2n]Discord[/url] or in the Steam [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1834120/discussions]Discussions[/url] forum!

notes.title: Patch Notes #2
notes.notes:
Today's update includes the following changes:
[list]
[*] [b]Localization support.[/b] The game now has localization support and a Japanese version.
[*] [b]Improved pixel art rendering.[/b] The in-game graphics are now better aligned with the pixel grid, resulting in better-looking art.
[*] [b]Ending screen removed from the levels menu.[/b] The ending screen used to look like a level you hadn't completed yet. Now you can properly enjoy the satisfaction of seeing your 100% completion rate.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes #1
notes.notes:
Today's update includes the following changes:
[list]
[*] [b]Additional keys for [i]zoom in/out.[/i][/b] The default key chosen for the [i]zoom in[/i] action was incompatible with some keyboard layouts. We've now included an extra pair of keys just in case. These can also be rebound in the options menu.
[*] [b]Performance improvements.[/b] Levels will load faster and memory consumption is lower.
[*] [b]Improved ultra-wide screen support.[/b] The level borders will now render more nicely on ultra-wide screens.
[/list]

This update was the first post-release patch. Future updates are already in the works. Stay tuned!

notes.title: News #4 - Released now!
notes.notes:
We're ecstatic to announce that the full game is [i][b]now released![/b][/i]

That being said, this is not the last you'll hear from the Ornbjorn team. We already have some updates in the works, so make sure to keep an eye on the announcements if that sounds interesting to you.

Finally, as always, [b]we'd love to hear from you![/b] You can always reach out directly to us, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1834120/discussions/0/3266809889824154127/]leave feedback[/url] through the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1834120/discussions]Steam Discussion board[/url] or on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/gRHWRGWY2n]Discord server[/url].

notes.title: News #3 - Release date: May 18
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to announce that [b]the full game will be released on the [i]18th of May![/i][/b] Mark the date in your calendar, for in just about a week you can take on the challenge of sliding through 100 puzzling ice mazes throughout Icemaze Cave.

Not only did the number of levels increase vastly since the Next Fest demo. The helpful feedback we received back then led directly to several improvements that helped shape the experience for the better. With this in mind, we want to thank you all for your wonderful contributions and we wholeheartedly look forward to hearing what you think of the full game now that it is finally being released for everyone to enjoy! 

Just like when the demo was first released, [b]we'd [u]still[/u] love to hear from you![/b] You can always reach out directly to us, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1834120/discussions/0/3266809889824154127/]leave feedback[/url] through the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1834120/discussions]Steam Discussion board[/url] or on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/gRHWRGWY2n]Discord server[/url].

notes.title: News #2 - Next Fest
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce our participation in the upcoming Steam Next Fest!

During the event, we encourage you to try the game in our [b]pre-release [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1897850/Icemaze_Cave_Skate_Escape_Demo]demo[/url][/b] and to reach out to us with any [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1834120/discussions/0/4543572243344061071/]feedback[/url], thoughts and comments.

Our ambitions with this festival are to have more people play the demo and to get valuable feedback from players to create an even better experience when the full game launches in Q2 2022.

If you haven't done so already (or if you want to do it again), then [b]make an impact[/b] by playing the demo and telling us what you think about it! Test your navigational skills in 10 levels that are [i]available now[/i]. No matter if you prefer exploring and taking detours for valuable minerals or navigating through the mazes on the shortest paths possible, we're confident that you'll enjoy the demo!

[b]We'd love to hear from you![/b] You can [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1834120/discussions/0/4543572243344061071/]leave feedback[/url] regarding the demo or otherwise reach us through the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1834120/discussions]Steam Discussion board[/url] or on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/gRHWRGWY2n]Discord server[/url].

notes.title: News #1 - Demo released!
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce that a pre-release [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1897850/Icemaze_Cave_Skate_Escape_Demo]demo[/url] is now available[/b]!

Go ahead and test your navigational skills throughout 10 levels [i]right now[/i]! No matter if you're the collector taking detours for valuable minerals or the expert navigator sliding through the mazes on the shortest paths, we hope you'll enjoy it.

[b]We'd also love to hear your [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1834120/discussions/0/4543572243344061071/]feedback[/url][/b] on the demo. This'll help us improve it for the full release in Q2 2022. Make an impact by playing the demo and telling us what you think about it! It could be anything from the good, the bad, or even the ugly parts of the experience for you. We strive to make the upcoming full game an even better experience!
